title: postbiotic-lta-audit: what the sequence record can and cannot say about lipoteichoic acid D-alanylation
description: Code, calling criteria and data for the manuscript 'Standardizing postbiotics: a genome cannot supply the value, and lipoteichoic acid shows what to state instead'. Screens 9,143 deposited RefSeq assemblies for the capacity to remove D-alanine from lipoteichoic acid, resolving gene presence, predicted localization and substrate-contact conservation; audits the public annotation of that enzyme; and tests measured substitution values against the resulting classification. No new sequence and no new laboratory measurement were generated. Calling criteria are held outside the code and the pre-registration record states when each was fixed.
